source_excerpts.text:
## 4. The encoder now has a common memory map and a genuine relative full-rank bound

The physical source construction was also strengthened.

The known anchor and old parity factors are transported through an actual four-dimensional half-erasure channel. The finite purifier is explicitly retained in the physical leaf. Background and signal records now share one bistochastic memory map
\[
\Phi(X)=\sum_rL_rXL_r^\dagger.
\]
For every incoming operator \(X\), including an untouched quantum history,
\[
\operatorname{Tr}_{A,F}V_zXV_z^\dagger
=
\pi_Q\otimes\Phi(X).
\]

The root cross map is a known physical operator tensored with that same \(\Phi(X)\). This makes the root-to-node mixed SLD and BKM terms linear traces, eliminating the previous mismatch between the signal-root map and the complete background map.

A further redistribution of a known white component makes every finite scalar record full rank while preserving:

- The exact memory map \(\Phi\).
- The stationary normalized source state.
- The constant-denominator marginal.
- Every root and node cross map.

It yields the arbitrary-history inequality
\[
cI_J\otimes\Phi(X)
\le
\rho_{JM}(X)
\le
I_J\otimes\Phi(X),
\]
for computable \(c>0\). Common future completely positive processing of the memory and history preserves it. At the normalized stationary input, this recovers genuine scaled source spectral bounds.

**The scope is the source marginal after tracing the finite purifier \(F\).** The actual leaf retains \(F\); the inequality is not automatically a bound on the full leaf state or the global Gram matrix.

The outstanding environmental edge terms remain uncontrolled. Local intertwining within an honest projector context does not establish entropy cancellation across different contexts. The attempted replacement by geometric/Lüders entropy edges has not yet been compiled with a complete no-case proof.
